step_variables._configuration_schema:
[
  {
    "title": "Pull Sample Events in Past X Minutes",
    "name": "minutes",
    "type": "text",
    "tooltip": "Pull the events in the past X minutes. e.g. 10 minutes.",
    "required": true,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "value": 10
  },
  {
    "title": "Maximum Records to Fetch",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "type": "integer",
    "name": "limit",
    "value": 50,
    "tooltip": "The maximum number of records to return. Default: 50",
    "description": "Maximum number of records that this operation should return."
  }
]
